To: June Osei-Lark  
Date: 2/16/26  
Subject: Covey & Lark is now Pellow Home Living

June — forwarding the notice below. From today, Covey & Lark Retail is Pellow Home Living. Please change the CRM code from CLR to PHL. Name field too, pls.

Caught this between calls. Their receiving team already has the new name on the morning appointment sheet, but the Pemberline Dock export still says Covey & Lark Retail. Confused the desk at door 6; driver was sent around to the office to check his paperwork. Same delivery, just the old heading.

I'll pick up the export label issue with support. Can you do the CRM bit today and ping me when it's done? Need it sorted before I send the followup.

---------- Forwarded message ----------  
From: Receiving Office, Pellow Home Living  
Date: 2/16/26  
Subject: Company name change — effective today

Hi Sofia,

Effective today, Covey & Lark Retail is Pellow Home Living. Please udpate your records and use the new name on appointment confirmations.

Receiving contacts and delivery instructions remain unchanged. Thanks!
